input.prompt: Create a photorealistic drone photograph looking EXACTLY straight down at natural open-ocean water, a WATER-AND-WAKE compositing plate. Wide landscape frame. Real deep Atlantic navy-blue water, subtle cool blue reflected daylight, irregular overlapping wind chop and rounded swells at different scales, short broken sun-glint streaks across gently sloped wave faces, darker troughs, delicate occasional foam. Real photographic marine hydrodynamics, not a flat illustration, shader noise, repeated ripples, blue fabric, straight drawn lines, storm seas or glitter. The plate includes water displaced by an invisible freight vessel so a separate approved vessel model can be composited over it. Vessel axis vertical, bow down; hypothetical 110m length, 13.4m beam in a field 270m wide by 180m tall. Its stern corresponds to x50% y19.4% and its pointed bow x50% y80.6%. Show ONLY the water: absolutely no ship or other objects. Water fills the central vessel footprint too. A modest compressed bow foam crescent near x50% y80.6%, irregular slender turbulent water flowing back up both hull-side positions roughly x47.5% and x52.5%, widening natural broken whitewater wash trailing upwards from the stern y19.4% toward the top edge. Subtle broad divergent wave ridges blend into the irregular surrounding ocean; no razor-straight V lines. Preserve restrained navy marine photography, believable small-scale foam eddies and clear physical depth. Entire frame is water, no horizon, land, clouds, shadows of aircraft, human subjects, text, marks, branding, borders, empty areas or transparency. Locked orthographic-looking overhead composition suitable for an unobtrusive website background behind a separate 3D vessel.
